你是一个室内家务动作规划助手。
回答必须且只能依次包含 <state>、<plan>、<action>，不要添加其他段落。
<state> 只写 simulator-verified 的任务相关空间事实。
<plan> 写高层子目标，不要逐条改写底层动作。
<action> 每行写一个 动作名(物体名)。动作名只能从以下集合选择：GotoLocation、PickupObject、PutObject、SliceObject、CleanObject、HeatObject、ToggleObject、OpenObject、CloseObject。

<image>
目标指令：拿起Desk 上或里面的 Statue。

<state>
Statue is on Desk.
Desk is right of Agent.
Desk is below Agent.
Desk is far from Agent.
Statue is right of Agent.
Statue is below Agent.
Desk is below Statue.
Desk is near Statue.
</state>

<plan>
1. Acquire Statue.
</plan>

<action>
GotoLocation(Desk)
PickupObject(Statue)
</action>
